title: A Brief History of Computers
text: Early mechanical computing devices, such as Charles Babbage's Analytical Engine (1830s), laid conceptual groundwork for modern computers. The first electronic general-purpose computers emerged in the 1940s (e.g., ENIAC). The invention of the transistor (1947) and later the integrated circuit enabled dramatic miniaturization, leading to personal computers in the 1970s-80s and today's smartphones, which are vastly more powerful than early room-sized machines.
